description: Preparation path for the SAT Math section (digital SAT): 44 questions across 2 modules of 35 minutes each; ~75% four-option multiple-choice, ~25% student-produced response; calculator permitted throughout; no penalty for wrong answers. This unit covers the Algebra domain (~35% of Math): linear equations, functions, systems, and inequalities — sourced from College Board's published content domains. Reading & Writing unit added: Standard English Conventions (subject-verb agreement, verb tense, pronoun clarity) and Information and Ideas (main idea, inference) — per College Board's digital SAT Reading and Writing content domains (Craft and Structure ~13-15 Qs; Information and Ideas ~12-14; Standard English Conventions ~11-15; Expression of Ideas ~8-12).
title: SAT — Math: Algebra + Reading & Writing
